value: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, residential premises lease contract (Arts. 660-676).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: The residential lease must be in writing as a single document signed by the parties, is subject to notary certification, and the rights arising from it are subject to state registration (Arts. 662, 663).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: The lease is concluded for the term set by the contract; if no term is set it is treated as concluded for an indefinite term (Art. 672).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: Rent is set by agreement of the parties; unilateral change is not allowed except in cases provided for by law or the contract (Art. 671(1), (2)). Rent is paid monthly unless the contract provides otherwise (Art. 671(3)).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: The tenant and other citizens permanently residing with the tenant may, by common consent, terminate the lease by giving the lessor three months' notice (Art. 675(1)).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: The lessor may terminate only through court, for example where the tenant fails to pay rent more than twice after the payment term, or the tenant or persons they are responsible for destroyed or damaged the premises; eviction follows a court judgment (Arts. 675(2), 676).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: Transfer of ownership of the let premises is not a ground to rescind or alter the lease; the new owner becomes the lessor on the existing terms unless law provides otherwise (Art. 664).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: Maintenance repair is the tenant's duty and major repair is the lessor's duty, unless the contract provides otherwise (Art. 670).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.

value: Sub-letting is allowed with the lessor's consent; the sub-lease cannot exceed the main lease term (Art. 673).
source_publisher: ARLIS - Legal Information System of Armenia (official text)
note: Civil Code of the Republic of Armenia, English text with changes up to HO-394-N of 24 October 2024.
